definitions.explanation: A barbed hook for catching fish, tied to a fishing line. From {釣|つ}る (to fish) plus {針|はり} (needle, hook).

examples.japanese: {釣|つ}り{針|ばり}に{餌|えさ}をつける。
examples.english: To put bait on the fishhook.

examples.japanese: {魚|さかな}が{釣|つ}り{針|ばり}にかかった。
examples.english: A fish got caught on the hook.

examples.japanese: {海|うみ}で{釣|つ}りをしていたら、{釣|つ}り{針|ばり}が{岩|いわ}に{引|ひ}っかかってしまった。
examples.english: While fishing in the sea, my hook got caught on a rock.

notes:
From {釣|つ}る (to fish) plus {針|はり} (needle, hook); は voices to ば in the compound.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {釣|つ}り{針|ばり}に{餌|えさ}をつける: to bait a hook
- {釣|つ}り{針|ばり}にかかる: to be hooked / to take the bait
- {釣|つ}り{針|ばり}を{外|はず}す: to remove the hook

USAGE:
{釣|つ}り{針|ばり}にかかる is also used figuratively to mean 'to fall for a trick or lure'.
